cities.name: Ljubljana
cities.local_food_tip: Slovenačke supe, krompir jela, salate, štrudle i lagani mediteransko-alpski ukusi.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏰 Ljubljana Castle (Exterior viewpoints). → 🌊 Ljubljanica River walk. → ☕ Old Town café.

Afternoon: 🎭 Triple Bridge & Prešeren Square. → 🍽️ Lunch: soups, salads, pastries. → 🌿 Tivoli Park walk.

Sunset: 🌅 Castle hill viewpoints.

Night: 🌃 Riverbank lights + dessert stops.
